title: BATCH-26 FOLD 3: the PAPER window in the same client-owned GYM with the VISUAL PACE TURNED OFF (`skippace 1` on both machines) - the decoration is gone, the accounting must not move. NO save.
preconditions: Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (day 44, MERGED - vars.keepMerger true). Dev build with skipvote / skipstate / shopday / employees / schedcount / tilldupes / perf / skippace / enterbuilding / exitbuilding (BAMP_DEV). THE SHOP IS THE GYM at vars.shop, the same shop t-shopday-paper measures, with `skippace 1` set on BOTH machines so no body, animator or wait is sped up at all. THE PICTURE MUST NOT CHANGE THE MONEY: the identity must still hold and the takings must be of the same order as the paced leg, picked by t-shopday-pick: of the four player-owned customer shops it had by far the most shopper entries for the measured morning (gym 203, fast food 137, hairdresser 74, clothing 40, read on each shop's OWNING machine). ITS OWNER IS THE CLIENT, so Client1's machine runs its live customers and its till and is the machine whose numbers matter; the host stands inside the same gym and waits. The fixture loads at 17:38 with Client1 already inside a building, so both step outside for a setup skip to 10:45 the next morning - that skip is taken OUTDOORS, with no shop occupied. BATCH-26 FOLD 3: the LIVE skip-shop mode and its lever are deleted, so there is no mode to set; the paper simulator is the accountant during every skip. The owner's row now also carries the ACCOUNTING IDENTITY (idDue = idBilled + idFloor + idNosale + idCapDrop + idUnbilled, with idUnbilled 0), the H-SKIPWALKIN-1 hand-back counters, and the fold-3 measurements (visit length in game minutes, follower puppet lag, the churn counters). NOTHING IS SAVED. ORACLE NOTE: the NullReferenceException oracle carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind (as t-skippace-watch does) because fx-hq1 prints the mod's own '[Gley] swallowed NullReferenceException' traffic-collider diagnostic, which has nothing to do with this fold.

steps.note: both worlds settle before anything is measured
fx-hq1 loads Client1 inside a building; report-only, an outdoor player only warns
the SHIPPED rate is what is measured - read, not set, so a drift fails here
the SETUP skip: 17:38 -> 10:45 next day, ~20 s at rate 50, taken outdoors
the setup skip finished - every number below is measured in the morning it reached
THE OWNER (Client1) STANDS IN HIS OWN GYM - his machine runs its live customers and its till
the other player waits inside the same gym and does nothing else
the floor fills at NORMAL speed - this is the 'before' every leg starts from
THE PICTURE OFF: a max visual pace of 1 turns D-SKIPPACE-1 off on this machine - no scaled agent, no scaled animator, no divided wait.
THE FLOW PREMISE: shoppers are still due today at this shop. Without this the leg could 'pass' on a dead shop and the table would compare two zeros.
THE SECOND HALF OF THE PREMISE: bodies are really standing on the floor at normal speed before the window opens.
the window's START clock in raw game-minutes - the end is compared against it
ONE consensus skip over the SAME three game hours the normal leg waits out - ~3.6 real seconds at rate 50
the skip runs and the world settles behind it
the measured skip finished
THE DRAIN: 60 real seconds at normal speed so bodies mid-checkout when the window closed can finish, and a paced body that failed to restore would show up here
THE WINDOW REALLY RAN: the clock is past where it started
the pace stayed off for the whole window and no body was ever scaled.
the pace stayed off for the whole window and no body was ever scaled.

THE OWNER'S TABLE ROW, and the fold's assertion: the ACCOUNTING IDENTITY holds (idUnbilled=0 - every entry that came due is billed, on the floor, a no-sale, or a native capacity drop) and the floor never went over the shop's capacity.
the FOLLOWER's view: puppet lag and the churn counters, which until this fold were reset every 10 s without ever being printed.
NO ORDER REACHED THE TILL TWICE - the H-SKIPDOUBLE-1 invariant this fold must not break
